messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #8421 landed but there are two outstanding items on the Regions & Data Residency page:
- wording: legal prefers "data residency" vs our draft "data locality"
- SDK snippet: need matching JS + Python header examples and a note about region header precedence

sam: On it, pushed a small patch to the PR that changes the header to `x-redwood-region: eu-west-1` in the JS snippet.

jlee: Can you paste the current snippet here so I can smoke-test the quickstart?

maria: ```js
// JS example
await client.responses.create({
  model: "redwood/text-v1",
  input: "Hello",
  headers: { "x-redwood-region": "eu-west-1" }
});
```

maria: ```py
# Python example
resp = client.responses.create(
  model="redwood/text-v1",
  input="Hello",
  headers={"x-redwood-region": "eu-west-1"}
)
```

ana: Quick legal note — please use the phrase "data residency" everywhere and add the footnote: "Data residency may be subject to contractual agreement and applicable law." I'll review the final wording.

sam: I'll add the footnote and link to the contract clause in the PR body. Also added a link to the preview: https://deploy-preview-8421--docs.redwood.com/regions#data-residency

docs-bot: build preview is up — https://deploy-preview-8421--docs.redwood.com/ (checks: spellcheck, lint)

jlee: LGTM except the Python snippet still had `region_name` in the helper; changed locally to `region` to match header.

maria: Thanks — updated both snippets in the branch. Also flagged two i18n strings for translation (EN -> FR, DE).

sam: I'll open a translation ticket and assign to @anna-translations.

anna-translations: on it, ETA tomorrow morning.

ana: Legal signs off on the phrasing. Please include this footnote in the page footer as well.

jlee: Once docs-bot completes checks I'm happy to merge. @maria can you add a one-line changelog for release notes?

maria: Yep — will add changelog and push final commit. ETA EOD. :+1:

sam: thanks all.
